text:
one Montaigne quote I think of all the time

"If a man remembers how very many times he has been wrong in his judgement, will it not be foolish of him not to mistrust it ever after?"

textbook definition of humility...applies in mkts, life, everywhere. from Essais, Book 3, Ch. 13

Montaigne...another that shifted my worldview

"A generous heart should willingly reveal its inmost depths. It is either all good, or at least all human."

thats the true range of outcomes. all good, or all human

"few understand this" is an understatement

put yourself out there
